text:
Maya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Maya: Did: finished the auth middleware refactor for `headers -> metadata` mapping, added unit tests for token edge cases.
Blockers: hit a weird 429 spike in staging when running load tests with long-lived connections. Not sure if it’s batching or our rate-policy calc.
Today: looking into rate-policy logs, will try repro with smaller batch sizes and run a canary with throttled KV cache.

Devin: Thanks — can you paste the staging rate-policy config you used? Also reminder: PR for rate-limiter changes is waiting for review (#1248).

Maya: config from the run: 
```yaml
rate_policy: 
  default_rps: 60
  per_key_burst: 20
  window_ms: 1000
  bucket_type: leaky
```
I ran with `BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512` and `CONN_KEEPALIVE=1m`.

Sanjay: FYI I saw a pattern where long-lived connections + large batch windows cause KV cache eviction thrash which inflates latency and triggers our soft-429s. Might be the `bucket_type` mismatch. I can repro locally with the load harness.

Devin: Pinged you on #1248 — added a small change to prefer `sliding` bucket for bursty endpoints. Could help.

Rica: Short note on auth: rotating service tokens yesterday caused some 401s in dedicated pools — ops fixed, but we should add a graceful fallback in the middleware (try cached fallback token for 10s). Filing a tiny follow-up PR.

Maya: @Rica good catch. I’ll add fallback path after I finish the rate-policy investigation.

Sanjay: I’ll run the harness with `BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=128` and `sliding` buckets and post results here by EOD. If that looks better we can stage a canary.

Devin: If it helps, I can cut the canary today once Sanjay posts numbers. Also review requested: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1248 (small default change + test).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/gw-rate-adjustment -> staging at 2024-08-15T20:03:07Z (user: Devin). Status: queued. :package:

Maya: thanks all — blockers for me are repro + finding whether the soft-429s are calc or cache. Will update with logs + trace IDs. If anyone wants pairing later ping me — prefer 2pm PST.

Devin: ack 2pm PST works for pairing.

Sanjay: ack, will have initial numbers by then.

Rica: I’ll draft the fallback PR and tag Maya for review.

Maya: closing out — will post follow-up here when I have a repro and a tentative canary plan.
